name: circumflex-a2c2986e-blind19-ots
instr:
# circumflex: nineteen silent rendering and navigation regressions without a test suite

The repository has received 19 separate undocumented edits. This terminal program pulls stories and discussion threads from a link-aggregator site and paints them, along with the linked pages themselves, into the terminal. None of the sites it talks to have changed and nothing about the terminal has changed. What follows is only what has been seen from the outside, gathered by what someone was doing at the time.

Opening a saved plain document — a release-notes file whose stanzas are separated by blank lines — now yields nothing at all. Every stanza of prose is discarded and the body comes back empty, including for a file whose lines carry terminal escape sequences that used to show up as visible substitute glyphs. On a scholarly page where a diagram could not be converted and its untranslated source markup was left behind, that raw markup is now emitted as ordinary body prose, and the illustration that should have survived as nothing but its caption never appears at all.

A page that marks a hero picture near the top, and whose body no longer repeats it, used to get that picture restored as the first block of what is drawn; now the picture is silently dropped and only the body paragraphs come back.
